scope: Phase 2 scoped source and durable evidence foundation

scenarios.observation: Browser capture included tracked and untracked source while excluding .git and the user exclusion.
A fresh process reopened the exact retained snapshot and manifest identity.
A repeated byte-range read reused the durable identical artifact.
Excluded paths and traversal requests were rejected.
A changed file invalidated only dependent observations; unrelated evidence remained current.
Markdown and JSON reports retained all 15 security families as unexamined and claimed no finding.
Revocation prevented subsequent manifest and source access through the handle.
A source symlink to /etc/passwd was rejected without following it.
A FIFO special file was rejected without opening it.
Independent sha256sum values matched ordinary-file manifest identities.
Killing the daemon during a 1 GiB sparse-file capture admitted no scope; resume reissued the retained request and recovery removed private stale staging.
A damaged copied artifact was quarantined, admitted no partial result, and returned actionable fail-closed recovery guidance.
Touching a 512 MiB source during capture caused mixed_source_revision and published neither index nor staging.
A source root overlapping private module state was rejected before that private state was created.
A 109-file manifest was retrieved across two browser-visible pages.
A source path containing spaces captured and read successfully.
An EOF range at offset 40 of a 40-byte file returned 40..40 and the SHA-256 identity of empty bytes.
A zero-byte source file captured and read with the SHA-256 identity of empty bytes.
A range beginning beyond EOF was rejected as source_range.
Zero-byte requested length and a request above 1 MiB were rejected as invalid_read_request.
An exclusion containing ../outside was rejected as unsafe_source_path.
Removing one observed file invalidated only that path's observation.
A fully unchanged refresh reused all four files and all 183 bytes.
The final foundation checkpoint was published and durably acknowledged.

project_peritus: cargo build -p peritus-cli -p peritus-daemon -p peritus-tui -p peritus-web
known_external_blockers: Workspace-wide cargo fmt --check encounters pre-existing deleted shell-tool fixture files.
Workspace-wide strict Clippy encounters the existing unrelated lint backlog.
